meta.title: DIU Ride - Live Active Posted Rides
meta.description: Real-time persistent repository of currently active, non-expired campus rides with available seats. Read by DIU Ride AI Companion.

auto_removal_rules.on_completed: Automatically removed when trip is finished.
auto_removal_rules.on_expired: Automatically removed when departure time passes by 10 minutes without extension.
auto_removal_rules.on_cancelled: Automatically removed when driver or admin cancels/deletes the ride.
